lines.zh: 脚步声缓慢，似枯枝摩擦
lines.en: Slow footsteps, like dry twigs grinding.

lines.zh: 脚步轻踩地面，发出轻微声响
lines.en: Feet tap lightly, making a soft sound.

lines.zh: 摇摇晃晃地走着，如同行尸走肉
移动缓慢，偶尔发出低吼
蹒跚前行，似乎每一步都耗尽力量
lines.en: Shambles forward, each step draining energy.

lines.zh: 步伐不稳，似乎快要倒下
摸索着前进，似乎在寻找什么
缓慢而谨慎地移动，目光警惕
lines.en: Moves slowly and cautiously, eyes alert.

lines.zh: 摇摇欲坠地行进，几乎无法站立
lines.en: Falls forward, barely able to stand.

lines.zh: 摸索着靠近，似乎犹豫不决
用木棍探着塌陷的地面。
lines.en: It probes the caved-in ground with a stick.
It walks a few steps, stops, and looks back.

lines.zh: 空洞的目光注视着远方
lines.en: Empty gaze staring into the distance.

lines.zh: 半张嘴发出轻微嘶嘶声
lines.en: Muttering a faint hiss through half-open lips.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出低沉的喘息声
目光停留在你身上，似乎在思考
lines.en: Eyes fixed on you, seemingly pondering.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，似乎认出了你
我攥着一块铁皮，等你转身。
lines.en: I clutch a scrap of iron, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 目光警觉，似乎有所察觉
目光锐利，似乎在寻找弱点

lines.en: The gauze is soaked through; who has bandages?
I'm coughing blood; help me up.
Your flesh is calling to me.
Move; I'm carrying a wounded man.
You're too slow, I'm ramming you.
Stay back; I still have a knife.

lines.zh: 末世里，两个人守夜才熬得住。
lines.en: In this world, two people on watch can last the night.

lines.zh: 末世里，人多一点才活得久。
lines.en: In the apocalypse, more people means living longer.
Eats some meat to regain energy.

lines.zh: 我得先动手，才活得下去。
lines.en: I have to strike first to keep living.

lines.zh: 背包带系紧，这一架躲不掉。
lines.en: Pack straps tight; this fight can't be avoided.

lines.zh: 我攥紧砖头，等你再走一步。
lines.en: I grip the brick and wait for one more step.

lines.zh: 背包背好，我跟你走一趟。
lines.en: Pack's on — I'll walk with you a while.
Your cooking smoke brought it over.

lines.zh: 它闻出了你身上的药味。

lines.en: It halts half a street away.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子当成丧尸。
lines.en: It mistook your shadow for a zombie.
It picks up a brick and holds it tight.
Eyes on target, ready to attack.
Locked on target, ready to bite.
Aiming at target, ready to feed.
Keeping eyes on target, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，膝盖在打颤。
lines.en: I crouch low; my knees are shaking.
Eyes on target, ready to move.
Eyes on target, ready to devour.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的干粮袋咽口水。
lines.en: I stare at your ration bag and swallow.
Eyes on target, ready to tear.
Eyes on target, ready to bite.
It raises the brick to shoulder height.
It slides along the broken wall sideways.
It stares at the canteen on your belt.
It swallows and does not back off.
It wraps its sleeve tighter around its wrist.
It shifts between you and the doorway.
It holds its breath to stifle a cough.

lines.zh: 别看我还在喘，我已是尸体。
lines.en: I still breathe, but I'm already a corpse.
Feel the taste of the End!
Don't make me get up again.

lines.zh: 指甲断了也要抓你一脸。
lines.en: Even with broken nails, I'll rake your face.

lines.zh: 这一片街区没人比我熟。
lines.en: Nobody knows this block better than me.
Feel the cold of the Nether!
No venom fangs, but the brick is hard enough.
This brick has cracked zombies before!
Leave the canteen. You may go!
I cough blood and still beat you!
Do not take me for one of them!
I have held this street first!
Hunger drives me to find meat!

lines.zh: 警戒线是我拉的，别越过去。
lines.en: I strung that warning line; don't cross it.

lines.zh: 这条街归我，先交出水壶。
lines.en: This street is mine; hand over your canteen.

lines.zh: 背包空了，我得翻下一个超市。
lines.en: My pack is empty; I need to search the next store.
I am a survivor of the end!
I hid behind this wall for three days.

lines.zh: 街上的丧尸散了才敢出来。
lines.en: I only came out once the zombies thinned.

lines.zh: 我从二楼摔下，脚踝歪了。
lines.en: I fall from the second floor and twist my ankle.

lines.zh: 水漫过胸口，我抓着水管。
lines.en: Water rises past my chest; I cling to the pipe.
The ruin blew apart and my ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 箭卡在背包带上，我动不了。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my pack strap; I can't move.

lines.zh: 咒文一碰，旧伤口又裂开。
lines.en: The spell touches me and my old wound splits open.

lines.zh: 雷落在铁皮上，浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the sheet metal; I'm numb all over.
